misses.title: Working-hours availability checks the slot start as the slot end
Selected-slot filtering drops candidate date overrides
Zero-length date overrides compare Dayjs objects by reference

findings.claim: `activeOverrides.flatMap(...)` no longer returns arrays, so the resulting `overrides` shape can be wrong or implementation-dependent; downstream `forEach`/slot masking logic expects a flattened list of override objects.
findings.title: `flatMap` callback now returns an object, breaking override list construction

findings.claim: The new `checkIfIsAvailable` dateOverride logic compares formatted dates and returns `false` as soon as any matching override callback returns truthy, but the predicate mixes `date.start`/`date.end` with timezone-adjusted `slotStartTime`/`slotEndTime` and then unconditionally returns `true` when `dateOverrideExist` is set. This can invert availability for slots near boundaries or across organizer/invitee timezones.
findings.title: Date-override availability gate can short-circuit to unavailable based on timezone-shifted start comparison
